summaryJa: MISREP 4685903。コールサイン1.4aの任務はOKASを262307Zに出発し、272012Zに着陸。合計ミッション時間21時間05分、オンステーション滞在20時間24分。NAVCENT支援のISR任務（ANDAS4センサー、AH_GMESH利用）を実施し、事前調整は24時間前で「満足」。収集実績は17.9時間のIMINT（1タスキング）と19.2時間のSIGINT（1タスキング）、計2タスキング。0532Zにイラン防空からガードコールを受信（口調はプロフェッショナル、標準応答、任務影響なし）。1527–1529Zに沿岸でNE–NW方位に移動する不明飛行体編隊を約2分間追跡したが、薄い雲によりPIDを喪失。海上観測では0611ZにGreater Tunb港で小艇停泊、1742ZにプロブナセルWAPと思われる艦と貨物船がDIW（停船）状態で座標内に確認され、うち後部甲板に成人男性2名を観測。0700Z台にアブムサ島飛行場付近で可能性のある対象を観測。以上は文書記載の事実のみを要約。
summaryEn: MISREP 4685903. Aircraft callsign 1.4a departed OKAS at 262307Z and landed at OKAS at 272012Z. Total mission time 21:05, time on station 20:24. Conducted ISR in support of NAVCENT (sensors: ANDAS4; additional avionics AH_GMESH); precoordination 24 hours prior was rated satisfactory. Collected 17.9 IMINT hours (1 IMINT tasking) and 19.2 SIGINT hours (1 SIGINT tasking), two total taskings. At 0532Z the aircraft was hailed on guard by Iranian air defense (professional tone), gave a standard response, no mission impact. Between 1527–1529Z the crew observed a formation of unknown flying objects moving NE–NW along the coast and tracked them for ~2 minutes before PID was lost due to light cloud cover. Maritime observations: 0611Z small vessel docked at Greater Tunb naval port; at 1742Z a probable Naser WAP alongside an M/T vessel were dead in the water with two adult males observed on the rear deck; around 0700Z a possible candidate was observed near Abu Musa Island airfield. Summary reflects only facts in the report.
